author: Axvser
name: VeloxDev Jalium Workflow Minimap Overlay
description: A styled minimap overlay for a Jalium.UI workflow surface.

minimapBackground.description: Minimap background color. Accepted for cross-GUI CLI parity; the adapter overlay owns the palette.

minimapBorder.description: Minimap border color. Accepted for cross-GUI CLI parity; the adapter overlay owns the palette.

nodeFill.description: Minimap node fill color. Accepted for cross-GUI CLI parity; the adapter overlay owns the palette.

viewportStroke.description: Minimap viewport stroke color. Accepted for cross-GUI CLI parity; the adapter overlay owns the palette.
